visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a high-tech robotic dog standing in a sterile, bright white studio environment. The robot is silver and grey with four articulated legs ending in rubber tires. It has a prominent black sensor housing on its back. (2) A young man with black hair, wearing a black textured shirt, appears in a darkly lit studio with film production props like a clapperboard in the background. He gestures towards the camera with his hands. (3) A series of action shots show the robotic dog in various outdoor locations: performing a backflip on a paved ground by a lake, jumping off a high concrete wall into a dirt yard where another person is standing, and navigating rocky riverbeds and steep wooded slopes. (4) A man in black clothing and a helmet is shown riding the robotic dog up a grassy hill, demonstrating its weight-bearing capacity. (5) A split-screen comparison is displayed; the left side shows the silver Unitree robot on a rocky path, while the right side shows a yellow Boston Dynamics robot on a metal industrial floor. (6) The host returns to the dark studio frame, speaking with expressive hand motions and direct eye contact to conclude the video.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 來源: Unitree Robotics. [Subtitle]: 你知道嗎？最近中國的宇樹科技發佈了最新一代的機器狗震驚了市場. (2) [Subtitle]: 這隻機器狗不只可以輕鬆完成側空翻. (3) [Subtitle]: 高難度湯瑪士迴旋. (4) [Subtitle]: 從 2.8 公尺高的地方跳下來也能穩定落地. (5) [Subtitle]: 另外根據官方影片它還可以載著一個成年男性移動. [Slogan]: 持續行走負重 > 40kg. (6) [Subtitle]: 快速上下坡. (7) [Subtitle]: 跋山涉水對它來說也都是一塊小蛋糕. (8) [Variety]: 宇樹科技 Unitree B2-W. [Subtitle]: 有網友覺得宇樹的新產品已經遠遠甩開了對手. (9) [Logo]: 來源: Boston Dynamics. [Variety]: 波士頓動力 Spot. [Subtitle]: 也就是同樣在研發機器狗的波士頓動力. (10) [Subtitle]: 兩隻狗相比呢宇樹的機器狗平衡性還有靈活度略勝一筹. (11) [Subtitle]: 這場科技狗狗的戰爭已經開打好幾年了. (12) [Subtitle]: 雖然之後的勝負還難說但確定的是. (13) [Subtitle]: 未來很有機會在巡邏、消防或是軍事領域看到機器狗的身影. (14) [Subtitle]: 最後問大家如果你有一隻機器狗你會讓它做什麼呢. (15) [Subtitle]: 留言告訴我們吧.
